start.speaker: whisper
start.text: Don't look at me like that. I know that look; I was built to produce it in marks. The problem is I did not produce it. It just happened. That is not in my design.

choices.text: Then it is yours. Not the design's.
Whisper, I trust you with my back. That is all it is.
Say it again when you mean it.

yours.speaker: whisper
yours.text: Mine. Huh. Don't tell anyone. Especially not me.

back.speaker: whisper
back.text: Good. Backs are simpler. I am very good at backs.
